route: Work permit (Department of Labour; Labour Act 2074, ss. 22-24; Labour Rules 2075)

permit.applies: The employer applies to the Department of Labour (or through a Nepalese embassy), after advertising
permit.first: The vacancy advertised in a national daily newspaper (copy uploaded to the Ministry of Labour's job portal), and no skilled Nepali citizen found

sources.title: Pioneer Law Associates, Labor Laws of Nepal (presentation, 3 November 2021); rests on the Labour Act 2074, ss. 22-24, and the Labour Rules 2075
sources.said: General Provision (Section 22): - Advertisement in national level Daily Newspaper*, - if no skilled human resource Nepali citizen is found, submit an application to obtain work permit. *Copy of vacancy advertisement published in the daily newspaper should be uploaded in the Job Portal of the Ministry of Labor. … The maximum period of Work permit: 5 years for the expert in technical field and 3 years for others. … The Labor Rules requires foreign nationals to renew the work permit prior to 30 days of its expiry. … Up to 6 months NRs. 15,000 The amount should be paid in the convertible currency if the application for work permit is submitted in the Nepalese embassy or any diplomatic agency. More than 6 months NRs. 20,000

sources.title: Pradhan & Associates, Implementation of Labor Rules 2075 (2018); rests on the Labour Rules 2075
sources.said: Depending on the foreign national’s skills, the Labor Permit or Work Permit may be valid for a maximum period of 3 to 5 years and may be renewed for up to two years in special cases after obtaining approval from the Ministry of Labor, Employment and Social Security
